About me

Code, craft, and calm troubleshooting.

I’m a fresh Informatics graduate from Universitas Islam Indonesia with a strong interest in information technology, software development, UI/UX, and problem solving. My thesis applied the Squirrel Search Algorithm to courier route optimisation in Python and was published in a Sinta 5 journal.

I’ve developed web and mobile applications, supported IT operations at real events, and worked in organizations and committees, which taught me to ship under pressure and work well with people.
